description: This file implements functions for the HTTP Message Body Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It is part of a larger HTTP implementation within a system, handling message body container functionalities.

classes.name: HTTP_MESSAGE_BODY_OBJECT
classes.description: The primary object representing HTTP message body, with methods for managing the body content, state, and associated interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpMboCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new HTTP Message Body Object, setting function pointers and default states.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the message body object, freeing resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls or registers sub-objects or dependencies needed by the message body object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the message body object, setting default values and function pointers for object methods.
